composition_subtypes.role: decide to drink or replace with less negative potion
maintain min heap of taken negative potions for O(log n) replacement

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedily drink potions keeping health non-negative; if not possible, replace the most negative taken potion with current if better, using min-heap for efficient min access.
payload.rationale: Solution iterates left-to-right, greedily taking potions and using a min-heap to track negative ones, enabling replacement with a better option when health would become negative.
